$comment: The HTML skill's reviewed string builders (AGENTS.md, "Data is drawn as text, and a destination is checked"; scripts/check-sinks.mjs). Each file's count of the places a string becomes markup or a page is sent somewhere, what the file writes there (takes), why it is safe (safe), and whether it writes values a page passes in (data: such a module is in the hostile-input probe, test/support-hostile.mjs, and test/sinks.test.mjs fails if it is not). A count that changes is a change to review: raise it with the reason, or lower it.

core.js.takes: an icon's drawing with its data-label, and a copy of a bar's own measured markup
core.js.safe: the label goes through esc; the copy is markup already in the page

modules/braille.js.safe: a constant drawing; nothing from the page

modules/chart.js.takes: a chart's figure, its plot and its table, from the page's chart JSON
modules/chart.js.safe: every word and number goes through esc; ids are the module's own

modules/combobox.js.takes: an option's row and its check glyph
modules/combobox.js.safe: labels and descriptions are set as textContent; the row markup and the glyph are constants

modules/command-list.js.takes: the list's frame from its data-label, data-noun and data-placeholder, and a detail pane's string from the author's own detail function
modules/command-list.js.safe: the attributes go through esc; a detail string is the author's code, not data

modules/copy.js.takes: the button's own markup, and the copied or failed state's glyph and words
modules/copy.js.safe: markup the button already held, and constants

modules/diagram.js.takes: a diagram's figure, its words and its ink, from the page's diagram JSON
modules/diagram.js.safe: React's diagram engine (diagram-core.ts) writes them, escaping every text and attribute; a card's mark is a path compose.mjs read into a data: image

modules/filter.js.takes: its element helper's markup: the Clear button's word and the chip's glyphs
modules/filter.js.safe: constants only; the group's label and each value's label are set as textContent

modules/framed-art.js.takes: the art's alt text, shown when the image fails

modules/glyph.js.safe: drawings from the generated glyph set; the name picks one, it is never written

modules/kbd.js.takes: key chips from a data-kbd attribute
modules/kbd.js.safe: each key goes through esc; the modifier icons are constants

modules/links.js.takes: the visually hidden words that say a link opens a new tab or is external
modules/links.js.safe: the words are the module's own, through esc

modules/loops.js.takes: the toggle's play or pause glyph
modules/loops.js.safe: a drawing from the glyph set

modules/menu.js.takes: a checkable row's check or radio mark

modules/notifications.js.takes: the centre's frame, its foot and its entries, from the options a page passes
modules/notifications.js.safe: words go through esc; links pass safeHref; side and align are picked from the popover's values

modules/number.js.takes: a number field's two stepper buttons
modules/number.js.safe: constant markup and glyphs; the labels are the module's own

modules/palette.js.takes: the palette's frame, its rows and its spoken words, from the page's groups and items
modules/palette.js.safe: words go through esc; a link passes safeHref before it is followed

modules/sparkline.js.takes: a sparkline's drawing and its label, from the page's JSON
modules/sparkline.js.safe: the label and the empty text go through esc; the path is numbers

modules/still-table.js.safe: drawings from the icon and glyph sets

modules/terminal.js.takes: a terminal's lines, its title and its copy button
modules/terminal.js.safe: each line and the title go through esc; the button is constant

modules/theme.js.takes: the theme toggle's sun or moon icon

modules/toast.js.takes: a toast's content from Basalt.toast's options, and its drain bar
modules/toast.js.safe: words go through esc; status is a known value; the drain's duration is a number

modules/tooltip.js.takes: a tooltip's words from data-tooltip, and its key chips
modules/tooltip.js.safe: the words and keys go through esc

modules/topbar.js.safe: constant markup with the module's own id
